description: Drink to clear away all stress. Can be administered to another person. Stress by itself isn't life threatening, but an abundance of stress can make it impossible to successfully act or avoid threats. In a pinch, it might be good to have ways to clear it away quickly.
name: Soothing Potion

description: Drink to heal all body parts. Can be administered to another person. Rapid healing of injuries is miraculous, but is also quite taxing on the mind and body. Normally this isn't much of a drawback, but healing in a dangerous situation can leave one more vulnerable than when still injured.
name: Healing Potion

description: Drink to heal any mental damage. Can be administered to another person.
name: Mind Potion

description: Use to heal all damage to one body part. Can be administered to another person. Rapid healing of injuries is miraculous, but is also quite taxing on the mind and body. Normally this isn't much of a drawback, but healing in a dangerous situation can leave one more vulnerable than when still injured.
name: Medkit

description: A standard hand grenade, which unleashes an explosive shockwave laiden with deadly shrapnel. If thrown at an empty location, its large explosion can still catch nearby targets. Keep in mind that this includes allies!
name: Frag Grenade

description: A key to the warehouse, where the target is supposedly held.
name: Warehouse Key
